MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug and Echo Show 5 felt like useful additions to my Fire TV setup because they offer home controls beyond watching television.",
    "The WYZE camera fits my repeated interest in home monitoring, provided it is easy to set up and works with the devices I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick Lite repeats a capability I already have with my 4K stick and Fire TV television, without giving me a clear new benefit.",
    "The SSD, tablet, and wired headphones address needs I have not shown recently; buying electronics does not mean I currently want storage upgrades, another screen, or recording accessories.",
    "The older Echo devices felt less appealing when a newer speaker and a compact display were available, and I would choose the display for its additional uses."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seemed to lead to more Amazon devices even when their purpose did not fit what I need next.",
    "My electronics purchases seemed to be treated as broad interest in computer and audio accessories, although my recent choices center on television and cameras."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: an additional streaming stick needs a clear purpose beyond the devices I have.",
    "I am more interested in additions that help my existing setup do something useful, such as home controls or viewing compatible camera feeds, than in another device with overlapping functions.",
    "Alexa speakers fit my interests, but I would choose selectively; the compact display gives me a clearer reason to add one now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connected home devices but sometimes confused useful additions with redundant devices or unrelated electronics."
}
